chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a warm welcoming two-bar entrance: a rolling harp arpeggio and a soft music-box chime, like a door closing on the wind, settling onto the tonic}
positive_styles: warm D major with a wistful B minor turn
rounded lyrical pulse-wave lead with long held notes
relaxed round synth bass on quarter notes
soft brushed kick and hat, sparse
a distant soft wind swell once per phrase
cosy cliff-town indoor theme, lamplight and kites resting on the walls
